text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Holy cow! You got so many! Way to go,
Familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And they're all so soft and cute! They
look so
happy to have been grabbed up
and—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I don't think I'll push my worries
onto them,
after all. I can do anything
on my own!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And if push comes to shove, I can always
push my
worries onto you! I'll just put all
these in my room!
